description: Tier 0. All three services start and report healthy. Expect: exactly three lines, `app healthy`, `leadgen healthy`, `mailbox healthy`.
command: docker compose up -d --build --wait && docker compose ps --format '{{.Service}} {{.Health}}'

description: Tier 0. The bootstrap posts seed 42, reads ten leads and round-trips the probe. Expect: exit 0.
command: docker compose exec -T app python -m uwh.runtime.bootstrap | jq -e '(.lead_ids | length) == 10 and .lead_ids[0] == "LEAD-00000042-000" and .lead_ids[9] == "LEAD-00000042-009" and .probe.metadata_round_trip == true'

description: Tier 0. The probe is in the real mailbox with its metadata, read independently of the bootstrap. Expect: exit 0.
command: id=$(curl -s "http://localhost:8025/emails?limit=1" | jq -r '.[0].id'); curl -s "http://localhost:8025/emails/$id" | jq -e '(.lead_id | startswith("BOOTSTRAP-")) and .metadata.probe == true and (.metadata.run_id | type) == "string"'

description: Tier 0. The answer key is off by default and no application source names the debug path. Expect: `false`, then exit 0.
command: docker compose config --format json | jq -r '.services.leadgen.environment.DEBUG' && test -d src/uwh && ! grep -rn '/debug' src/

description: Tier 0. Stand's code is unchanged since the root commit and clean in the working tree. Expect: exit 0.
command: git diff --quiet "$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)" HEAD -- sim-harness && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- sim-harness)"

description: Tier 0. Every tracked text file has LF line endings. Expect: `0`.
command: git ls-files --eol | awk '$1 != "i/lf" && $1 != "i/-text" && $1 != "i/none"' | wc -l

description: Tier 0. The check command is clean. Expect: exit 0, no warnings or errors in the output.

description: Tier 0. The client and bootstrap integration tests pass against the containers. Expect: all pass.

description: Tier 0. `.env.example` documents the six variables and the default model. Expect: `6`, then exit 0.
command: grep -cE '^(ANTHROPIC_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_MODEL|TYPESAFE_API_KEY|RUN_MODE|SEED|DEBUG)=' .env.example && grep -q '^ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-sonnet-5-5$' .env.example

description: Tier 0. The Anthropic SDK version is pinned and the SDK check is recorded. Expect: `1`, then a number of at least 1.
command: grep -A1 '^name = "anthropic"$' uv.lock | grep -c '^version = ' && grep -c 'messages.parse' docs/progress.md

command: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/run | jq -e '.mode == "live" and .seed == 42'

description: Tier 0. Generated TypeScript types match the committed copy. Expect: exit 0.

description: Tier 0. The check command, with its web step, is clean. Expect: exit 0, no warnings or errors.

command: docker compose --profile eval run --rm eval --suite all

description: Tier 0. Every ready control is caught by its named grader; `not_ready` appears only for controls of tiers not built. Expect: exit 0.
command: docker compose --profile eval run --rm eval --controls all; tail -1 evals/results.jsonl | jq -e 'all(.controls[]; .state == "not_ready" or .caught == true)'

description: Tier 0. After a full demo on containers created with `--force-recreate`, the leadgen log shows the run and no debug request. Expect: exit 0.
command: docker compose logs leadgen | grep -q 'POST /queue' && ! docker compose logs leadgen | grep -q '/debug'

description: Tier 0. The README carries every required section and its skills table matches the code. Expect: tests pass; `12`.
command: uv run pytest tests/docs/test_readme.py && grep -cE '^## (Run it|Architecture overview|Human-in-the-loop|Queue orchestration|Outbound comms|Visualization|Integrations|Evals and iteration plan|Skills|Hit list|Cut and hand-waved|Platforms)$' README.md

description: Tier 0. App and eval images build for both architectures. Expect: exit 0.
command: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --target app . && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --target eval .

description: Tier 0. A clean clone starts with the one command. Stop the main project first; it holds the same host ports. Expect: three lines, `app healthy`, `leadgen healthy`, `mailbox healthy`.
command: d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q . "$d" && cd "$d" && cp .env.example .env && docker compose -p uwh-rehearsal up -d --build --wait && docker compose -p uwh-rehearsal ps --format '{{.Service}} {{.Health}}'

description: Tier 0. The README records a result for each of the three platforms. Expect: `3`.
command: grep -cE '^\| (macOS \(arm64\)|Linux \(amd64\)|Windows \(WSL2\)) \|' README.md

description: Tier 1. Replay of seed 42 reproduces the recorded mailbox content with no replay miss. Expect: all pass.
command: RUN_MODE=replay docker compose up -d --wait --force-recreate app && uv run pytest -m integration tests/integration/test_replay_seed42.py

description: Tier 1. No skill is `untested` at the release commit. Expect: exit 0.
command: uv run python -m uwh.skills.status --release-check
